item.name: 26. FINANCE (Bank / Expenses / Payments / Cashflow / Budgets / Taxes / Income / Reports)

request.description: Valid periods: Q1 2026, Q2 2026, Q3 2026, Q4 2026 (any year).

Expense summary report (manager+).

Response: date_from, date_to, total_expense, highest_category (name/amount), average_expense, and a list of {expense_id, name, category, amount, payment_method, date, description, status}.

Filters: date_from, date_to, category, status (paid/pending/approved), payment_method.

Income summary report (manager+).

Response: date_from, date_to, total_income, highest_category, average_income, income_growth (vs previous equal window), and a list of {income_id, party_name, category, amount, payment_method, date, status}.

Filters: date_from, date_to, category, status (pending/received/partial), payment_method.

Profit and Loss report (manager+).

Response: total_revenue (income status received/partial), total_expense (expense status paid/approved), net_profit = revenue - expense, margin_percent = net_profit / revenue * 100.

Filters: date_from, date_to.

Income vs Expense comparison (manager+).

Response: total_income, total_expense, net_difference, expense_ratio (expense/income*100), and periods list {period, income, expense, difference, trend (+/-)}.

group_by=month (default) gives YYYY-MM periods, group_by=year gives yearly periods.

Purchase tax summary report (manager+).

Response: total_purchase_tax, highest_tax_category, avg_tax_per_purchase, purchase_tax_growth, and a list of {bill_id, supplier, tax_type, tax_amount, payment_method, date, status}.

Filters: date_from, date_to, tax_type, status (failed/pending/completed), supplier.

request.description:
Purchase analytics dashboard (manager+).

Returns for the date range:
- total_spend, suppliers (distinct vendors)
- avg_lead_time_days (actual_delivery_date - order_date)
- on_time_percent and status (excellent >= 90 / good >= 75 / average >= 60 / poor < 60)
- records per supplier: vendor, requestors, total_spend, avg_lead_time_days, on_time_percent, status

Query params: date_from=YYYY-MM-DD, date_to=YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to last 30 days).
